summary: The bounded harness change addresses the right failure modes and preserves compatibility by making the register optional. Two decisions need definition before implementation: exact state and phase semantics for the gate, and the order of desktop shell selection versus final document review. The test plan also needs to exercise dispatch with a changed decision state.

open_findings.title: Define the decision-state and per-phase blocking rules
open_findings.description: The plan did not define valid states, what distinguishes assumptions from explicit delegation, whether each phase blocks, or what evidence permits resolution.
open_findings.required_correction: Define entry shape and state transitions, require resolution authority, preserve omitted-register compatibility, test every phase, and state the gate cannot find decisions that are omitted.

open_findings.title: Register the open shell decision and sequence its review before final architecture handoff
open_findings.description: The plan did not put shell selection in the desktop decision register and scheduled final document reviews before the shell comparison/decision.
open_findings.required_correction: Record shell as open/implementation-blocking; compare and review ADR, then reconcile dependent documents and refresh reviews/handoffs.

open_findings.title: Test dispatch recheck and stale packet behavior
open_findings.description: Tests did not cover a decision change between packet preparation and dispatch.
open_findings.required_correction: Add tests that stale/changed packets cannot dispatch and current resolved packets can.

validation: Read-only plan/harness review; no source changes or runtime checks.
